title: lem-pc-open-extension-projection-aux
statement: For a scheme X and open U with the specified derived categories, let R be derived restriction transported across the over-site equivalence. For every strong monoidal structure on R, every adjunction J ⊣ R, and all objects A and K, the adjunction transpose of the unit-tensor-monoidal-comparison morphism J(A ⊗ R K) → J A ⊗ K is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 08BS (lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open), proof: exact extension by zero; modules.tex Tag 01AK (lemma-j-shriek-exact); cohomology.tex 06YB (lemma-check-K-flat-stalks) and 06YH (definition-derived-tor)

proof.text: Use the derived-unit theorem on A and the supported-tensor counit theorem on J(A) tensor K. The morphism f = (unit_A tensor identity) followed by the strong monoidal comparison is invertible. The homEquiv_counit formula identifies its adjunction transpose with J.map f followed by the counit at J(A) tensor K. Both factors are invertible, so the transpose is invertible.

proof_origin.description: Separated and proved the derived-unit argument. Used the explicit counit formula for Hom transposition to combine it with the proved supported-tensor counit calculation; no separate reflection theorem is needed.

theorem openExtension_projection_formula_of_adjunction (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    let E := (Equivalence.functor
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ E
    ∀ (m : R.Monoidal),
      letI := m
      ∀ (J : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory X)
        (adj : J ⊣ R),
        ∀ (A : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X),
          IsIso ((adj.homEquiv (A ⊗ R.obj K) (J.obj A ⊗ K)).symm
            ((adj.unit.app A ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (R.obj K)) ≫
              (Functor.Monoidal.μIso R (J.obj A) K).hom))
